q: What is the main memory advantage of state-space models?
options: A fixed-size state per sequence instead of a KV cache that grows with every token
explain: Linear time and constant memory per sequence.

q: Which task is hardest for pure recurrent or state-space models?
options: Exact recall of a detail from far back in the context

q: What do hybrid architectures usually combine?
options: Many cheap recurrent or sliding-window layers with a few full-attention layers
